cohort: The study included 410 delivered mothers who gave birth at public health facilities in Metema district, northwest, Ethiopia.
finding: The magnitude of episiotomy practice was 44.15%, which is higher than the WHO recommended value, and was significantly associated with instrumental delivery, maternal age, oxytocin use, birth spacing, and perineal tear.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery was significantly associated with a higher likelihood of episiotomy practice.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from March 1 to April 30, 2020.
